findings.impact: The preparation path reports a rejected request instead of an incomplete timeout. During term checking, _resource_stop sees no timeout flag/code, so _check_goal treats the goal as an ordinary unresolved failure and the loop can attempt later goals after a resource deadline has expired. This violates the shared-deadline stop/no-later-stage contract and loses resource-stop reporting.
findings.recommendation: Handle TimeoutError separately as an incomplete timeout result (or otherwise make the supervised receipt expose timedOut=true) so the parent _resource_stop recognizes it and halts the remaining goal stages.
findings.title: Preserve deadline expiry as a resource stop in the route worker
findings.trigger: The shared absolute deadline expires while route preparation is staging the guarded prefix (the staging helper raises TimeoutError at its deadline checks) or while a term-stage operation raises TimeoutError. The worker main catches TimeoutError in the generic invalid-input exception handler and emits status=rejected with a nonzero exit; the supervisor then classifies it as worker-rejected rather than timeout.

limitations: No positive route runtime or full integrated regression gate was executed as part of this read-only audit; root owns those gates. No other source issue met the finding bar.
